objective: Deliver six distinct professional storefront themes, refreshed existing themes and three new styles, inspired by researched e-commerce patterns
acceptance_criteria: Six active themes exist with original distinct desktop/mobile layouts and shared truthful commerce controls
Theme gallery shows accurate previews and allows browsing/applying themes without altering catalog/orders
Theme settings persist brand/content customization and supported preview links do not publish draft shops
Search/category/sort/variants/cart/COD checkout/tracking work across all six themes
Production build, backend regressions and browser flow/visual checks pass and the running local stack contains the changes
non_goals: Copying retailer logos or copyrighted site layouts
